body:
Skye

Having an online website is a great way to show off your abilities and passion as a blogger.

One of the best places where you can get the best blog themes for your needs is Squarespace.

Which Squarespace template is best for blogging?

Actually, there’s a specific blogging template that is suitable for each kind of blogger, and one of these is Brower, which is best for business blogs.

On the other hand, if you write articles about food, then the Farro Squarespace template is a perfect choice.

"PS. Enjoy 10% off your entire purchase when you use code EBAQ at checkout."

I also included templates like Fillmore and Cailles, which are the best Squarespace themes for travel and interior design blogs.

All of these templates from Squarespace are highly recommended for bloggers, so you can choose which one best suites your needs.

So if you’re a writer or an author that has a passion for doing blogs, then here’s my list of the best Squarespace templates for blogging in 2022.

10 Best Squarespace Templates for Blog

  1. Brower—Best for business blog
  2. Farro—Best for food blog
  3. Skye—Best for lifestyle blog
  4. Rally—Best for personal blog
  5. Tudor—Best for review blog
  6. Haute—Best for fashion blog
  7. Native—Best for photography blog
  8. Fillmore—Best for travel blog
  9. Cailles—Best for interior design blog
  10. Wav—Best for music blog

By the way, if you’re a photographer, you can also check out my other article where I featured the best Squarespace templates for photographers.

1. Brower

As the first template on my list, I included the Brower template, which is a good option if you want a blog roll on your homepage.

The best Squarespace template for business blogs.

It is an eye-catching template for your business blog posts, so there's no need to look any further because this is the one for you.

This Brower blogging template is ideal for attracting viewers to read and browse your blog posts.‍

If you manage to combine this template with high-quality blog content, your website will definitely stand out.

The color and background of the template are perfect for featuring articles about business.

So, if you want to have the best business blog template from Squarespace, then the Brower is for you.

‍Download Brower Squarespace Template

2. Farro

The Farro is a template from Squarespace that is ideal for food bloggers because it is highly-customizable.

The best Squarespace template for food blogs.

It is considered one of the newest templates and has a greater level of control compared to older templates.

Farro is one of the most recommended Squarespace templates that is perfect for food blogging.

A custom site loading method can help you avoid having to reload the whole page.

When you use the Squarespace Farro template on your blog pages and posts, you can show header components as translucent overlays.

Content blocks may be used to simply personalize the site footer, which appears at the bottom of every page.

This method only pulls server data for certain parts of the page from the server.

As a result, pages with a lot of content can load much faster than they otherwise would.‍

Download Farro Squarespace Template

3. Skye

Your articles can be presented in a variety of visually appealing ways thanks to Skye’s variety of layout options and other special features.

The best Squarespace template for lifestyle blogs.

Due to the way it looks and works, this template is a great option if you want to make a blog about lifestyle, news, or a magazine.

The Skye template has a menu button that hides the side menus but still lets people choose how to get around.

Its navigation icons can launch a customizable overlay that can display text, graphics, links, and more.‍

The three related posts you can include at the bottom of each blog post serve as a guide for visitors to your site.

‍Skye template blog pages may also be adjusted into grid or mosaic layouts, and thumbnail images can be featured or deleted depending on the priority you wish to give your text.

So, if you’re looking for the best template for a lifestyle blog, then the Skye template is for you.

‍Download Skye Squarespace Template

4. Rally

If you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for personal bloggers, then Rally is a great option.

The best Squarespace template for personal blogs.

The Index-style homepage has so much content that a single blogger would not be able to fully utilize the content.

If you want, sections can be added to the Rally Squarespace template so that content can be put into groups.

These are posts that cover the whole width of the website.

This function can also be used to make these posts stand out.‍

There is a built-in search function in the Rally template's top double navigation.

Besides the main and secondary options in the header, you can also look at the options in the footer.

With the Rally blog design, a group of bloggers may easily publish new blog posts on a daily basis.

‍Download Rally Squarespace Template

5. Tudor

Tudor has three related posts that can be included at the end of each blog article for the benefit of the reader.

The best Squarespace template for review blogs.

Layout options for Squarespace blog templates include grid and mosaic.

Each blog post can have an author bio in the Tudor Template.

If you want to place the emphasis on your text, you may choose whether or not to display thumbnail images beside it.

The Tudor template was created with bloggers in mind, and it's a great option for any type of review blog.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for a review blog, Tudor is the perfect choice.

‍Download Tudor Squarespace Template

6. Haute

The Squarespace Haute design has three unique navigation panels, including customizable share buttons for product item pages and blog posts.

The best Squarespace template for fashion blogs.

This template also includes many settings for how your website appears on mobile devices.

If you use the Haute Template's header styling settings, you can make the header components appear as a transparent overlay on blog pages and posts.

Using text, images, and videos, you can change the header area on the Gallery, Events Albums and Products Pages to make them unique.‍

Your readers will love this "intro" section, which is a great way to get them excited about the rest of the page.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace template that fits fashion bloggers, Haute is for you.

‍Download Haute Squarespace Template

7. Native

If you’re looking for a Squarespace template that is perfect for a photography blog, the Native template is highly recommended .

The best Squarespace template for photography blogs.

Above the main navigation, the site title, tagline, and description are displayed in this Squarespace template.

With its long-scrolling page, the Native template lends itself well to blogging and writing.‍

The content of the footer can be changed as well, and it appears on all pages.

When you scroll down the Native page, you can move and resize images.

They can also be placed where you want them on the vertically scrolling page.

The default placement of social network icons in the footer of the Native template makes it simple to add social media links to your accounts.

‍Download Native Squarespace Template

8. Fillmore

When it comes to static page layouts that are perfect for travel blogs, Fillmore has several to choose from .

The best Squarespace template for travel blogs.

It includes a photo gallery and a FAQ-type page (named "Where to Fish" on the sample site).

There's no need to navigate beyond the enormous header image to get to the real blog material, and the photographs and descriptions pique your interest in each post.

In the editor, you'll be able to change things like a sidebar, header picture, or blog category navigation while keeping the aspects that make Fillmore so great.

The color and background of the template are perfect for writing a blog about the place that you visited.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for travel bloggers, then Fillmore is an ideal choice for you.

‍Download Fillmore Squarespace Template

9. Caillles

Cailles is the finest Squarespace template for an interior design blog because of all the features it provides.

The best Squarespace template for interior design blogs.

If you're looking for a template that's easy to understand and visually appealing, this one is for you.

On the Cailles homepage, the featured listings are given a lot of room, and the scale of the photographs helps visitors visualize the property.

Aside from these capabilities, the design also has an "About Us" and "Our Team" page that helps to develop trust with potential customers.

In addition to the "Schedule a Viewing" and "Subscribe to our Newsletter" buttons, visitors are also encouraged to sign up for our mailing list.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squrespace template for your interior design blog, Cailles is the perfect choice.

‍Download Caillles Squarespace Template

10. Wav

When you choose the Wav template for your website, you can make full use of Squarespace's social networking, music uploading, and online musical identity creation features.

The best Squarespace template for music blogs.

It's easy to make a beautiful website for your band or solo career with this Squarespace template. Your fans will love it!

SoundCloud integrations and a bold grid style make the Wav design ideal for musicians and bands who want to showcase their music on their websites.‍

Website owners can use the Wav to modify the navigation of their site, as well as the placement of their company logo and how mobile customers view their site.

Full-width banners and parallax scrolling are also included in the Squarespace Wav template.

It's possible to put video banner ads on some of the site's pages with the help of the Wav's parallax video features.

‍Download Wav Squarespace Template

Conclusions

If you're looking for a great template for your website, Squarespace is an excellent place to start.

If you're a professional blogger, you need a website template that shows off your skills.

What is the best Squarespace template for a blog in 2022?

There are a lot of template choices, but if you’re looking for the best Squarespace theme that is good for a photography blog, then Native is the best choice.

Also, if you’re into writing articles about music, the Wav is highly recommended.

All the Squarespace templates on my list are suitable for blogging, so it's your choice which is perfect for your blog.

I hope this article helps you to get an idea of which Squarespace templates match your preferences as a blogger.

Now that I'm done with my recommendation, which do you think is the best Squarespace template for bloggers in 2022? Leave a comment below.
